h:
抱歉！ V1.0 是错误的工作流程！

我看到了一些要求工作流程从 loras 列表生成多个示例图像的请求。我用它来比较 loras 之间的提示，或者为没有任何提示的提示生成示例图像。这利用了 KepListStuff (https://github.com/M1kep/Comfy_KepListStuff) 节点。

用途

这不是创建一个一体化工具，而是非常快速和肮脏的。

修改 lora 列表以添加您想要生成的文件名。该名称是根据您的模型/洛拉斯/目录。例如，我的按基本模型排序 -ComfyUI/models/loras/ZIT/modelname.safetensors,所以在我使用的列表中ZIT/模型名称.safetensors。每行一个。以同样的方式设置提示，每行一个。

  • 如果您想单独保存图像，请将预览节点替换为保存图像节点。

  • 您可以根据自己的喜好随意更改图像尺寸和模型强度。

o.en:
Apologies! V1.0 was the wrong workflow!

I have seen a few requests for a workflow to generate multiple sample images from a list of loras. I use this to compare prompts across loras, or to generate sample image for ones which do not have any. This makes use of the KepListStuff (https://github.com/M1kep/Comfy_KepListStuff) nodes.

Usage

Rather than creating an all-in-one tool this is very quick and dirty.

Modify the lora list to add the file names you wish to generate. The name is based on yourmodels/loras/directory. For example, mine are sorted by base model -ComfyUI/models/loras/ZIT/modelname.safetensors,so in the list i useZIT/modelname.safetensors. One per line. Set your prompts the same way, one per line.

  • If you would like to save the images individually, swap out the preview node for a save image node.

  • Feel free to change the image size and model strength to your own liking.
